_comment: A working list of terms met in practice that the published glossaries do not carry, supplied by the person who uses this app. They are NOT NATO-agreed terminology: the app labels them 'Other' so they are never mistaken for an official entry. An entry whose abbreviation and term already exist in an official source is dropped at build time rather than duplicated.

n: The source list records three readings and does not say which is meant; take it from the context.
Used as in "the CFACC delegates RR&A to ...".

entries.t: Air, Land, and Maritime Airspace Requirements
n: AAP-15 records the singular ACMREQ as airspace control means request.
GAT is guidance, apportionment and targeting; MAOP is the master air operations plan. Both are in this lookup.
